# Lineage memory — candidate witness only

This folder is not a runnable SLE World. It contains a synthetic common-founder
sampling kernel and an analytic discrimination witness. Bulk mean survival is
uninformative about retention; pairing and rest-dependent covariance can help.
No result certifies genetic resistance, biological realism or high difficulty.
See docs/v2/LINEAGE_PLAN.md for budget and the remaining admission gates.
